name: inspect_model_artifact
description: Inspect local GGUF v2/v3 or safetensors declarations by content, without loading models or executing code. Default hash header reads only the header: full-file SHA-256 and Evidence subject are unknown; artifact.header_sha256 is a scoped prefix commitment, not weight identity. hash full additionally streams all file bytes for SHA-256. Optional view returns a selected metadata/tensor/type page plus model context in this call. Summary retains complete Evidence for inspect_analysis_view kind model-artifact; its pages support selection, stable header-scoped indices and paging. Metadata arrays retain eight-element typed previews; scalar metadata is complete. Tensor counts, shapes, numeric type IDs and offsets are observed; textual types and parameter/storage totals use established format facts. Unknown or historically ambiguous GGUF types retain IDs with unknown nonempty byte lengths; ambiguous identities use AMBIGUOUS_<id> labels. Unresolved Q8_1 and K-block layouts also keep nonempty byte lengths unknown. Tensor payload, model behavior and inference quality are not inspected. One active inspection, 100 MB header ceiling and 32 MiB retained-facts budget; resource refusals are explicit. No network, external files, Python, model runtime, extraction or deserialization of pickle.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.
